findings.title: Thumbnail backfill can persist vault content through an older duplicate
findings.claim: Backfill can decode a newer vault payload and write its thumbnail onto an older CloudKit-mirrored synced row.
findings.evidence: Candidates retain a physical row's contentHash and byteSize, but decoding calls "loadWorkMaterialPayload(id: candidate.id)". That loader selects the newest physical row at lines 2788–2809 and may return vault bytes. The write at lines 2753–2758 checks "namesSyncedPayload(...candidate.contentHash...candidate.byteSize)" against each destination row without verifying that the decoded bytes match that candidate.
findings.scenario: CloudKit leaves two image rows with the same ID: older synced row A has hash A and no thumbnail; newer canonical row B names a readable vault image. Selection chooses A, loading reads B, and the write accepts A's unchanged metadata, persisting B's thumbnail into the synced store.
findings.fix: Load the synced blob using the candidate's exact ID/hash/size pairing instead of the general material loader; retain the transaction-time row checks.
findings.refutationAttempt: Checked canonical-row ordering, duplicate handling, vault reconciliation, and the existing duplicate-thumbnail test. Reads deliberately preserve physical duplicates; reconciliation only sweeps unreferenced vault files. The test duplicates identical payload metadata, so it cannot expose this mismatch. The destination-row check does not validate the loaded payload.

findings.title: Gallery fallback bypasses a refreshed card's availability
findings.claim: A stale readable tap can reopen an image that the current desk already identifies as syncPending.
findings.evidence: After filtering the desk through WorkboardCardActionPolicy, selection uses "let materials = openable.contains { $0.id == tapped.id } ? openable : [tapped]". This treats a present-but-refused card as absent. The router's earlier guard checks only the captured tapped snapshot; opening is scheduled asynchronously at line 847.
findings.scenario: A localOnly image is tapped; before the presentation task runs, a peer's reattachment updates the desk's same-ID card to syncPending. The current card is filtered out, but the fallback reinstates the old readable snapshot and opens its thumbnail in the gallery.
findings.fix: When the tapped ID exists in the current desk, use that current card and refuse presentation if its availability disallows opening. Restrict the standalone fallback to genuinely absent, openable cards.
findings.refutationAttempt: The existing tests cover a directly tapped syncPending snapshot and an ID completely absent from the desk. Neither covers an old readable snapshot whose same-ID current card is refused. The initial router guard therefore does not close this path.

findings.title: Vault images lose their existing Share action
findings.claim: Routing every image into the gallery removes sharing for vault images despite Slice A3's explicit requirement to keep ShareLink.
findings.evidence: The image presentation now renders "AttachmentFullScreenView(... fullDecodeMaxPixel: 4096)". The diff deletes the former file sheet's "ShareLink(item: url)", and no ShareLink remains in the main app. The gallery offers dismissal and Retry; the card menu offers no sharing replacement.
findings.scenario: Open an oversized image stored in the vault and try to export it. At ec8b27f its file preview supplied Share; at HEAD neither the gallery nor the card provides that action.
findings.fix: Restore sharing for readable images through a ShareLink backed by a disposable preview copy, preserving availability checks and file-lifetime rules.
findings.refutationAttempt: Quick Look retains system sharing for files and recordings, but images always bypass Quick Look. The a3 fixnote acknowledges the removal as an unresolved question; it does not supersede the binding plan's "Keep ShareLink" requirement.

findings.title: macOS never releases gallery neighbours under memory pressure
findings.claim: The required memory-pressure reduction of gallery residency is implemented only on iOS.
findings.evidence: "residencyRadius" starts at 1, and its only subsequent assignment, "residencyRadius = 0", is inside "#if os(iOS)" around UIApplication.didReceiveMemoryWarningNotification. There is no macOS pressure handler.
findings.scenario: On macOS, resident pages hold three large decoded images when memory pressure occurs. The radius remains 1, retaining neighbouring images instead of releasing them as required by plan line 25.
findings.fix: Add a macOS memory-pressure observer that reduces residencyRadius to zero for the remainder of the presentation.
findings.refutationAttempt: Checked every assignment to residencyRadius and searched the app for another memory-pressure handler. None covers macOS. The strict 4096-pixel bound limits individual images but does not release neighbouring images.

checkedInvariants: Capture and reattachment thumbnail generation uses the staged storage mode, preserves the syncedPayload persistence gate, and decodes through an @concurrent helper before the write context.
Backfill writes no updatedAt, visits every matching physical row, limits payload attempts to 96 with four concurrent jobs, and excludes overlapping passes on the same store instance.
Ordinary gallery selection preserves board order and filters unavailable images; the stale-tap exception is reported above.
Work originals use strict bounded ImageIO decoding; loader/decode failures expose Retry, and residency cancellation checks precede image assignment.
Quick Look preserves platform reclaim policies and stale-token disposal; destination changes invalidate Work claims, while Chat retains its visibility gate and cancellation.
Non-image card bodies, small-card layout, availability glyphs, context menus, and inline tile geometry match the base; accessibility composition retains kind, name, and exceptional availability.
Exactly one workboardViewModel.load() occurs in PersonalWorkbenchView.swift.
Bidirectional catalog checks found no missing or orphaned workboard.* or pendingRetry.* keys; both new gallery keys exist.
notes: Reviewed ec8b27f..692608d and the relevant plan, fixnotes, source, and tests. Checks were read-only source comparisons and in-memory predicate traces; no builds or XCTest suites were run. The worktree remains clean.
